title: rclone before 1.76.0 Credential Leak via Swift, NetStorage and Seafile Redirects (CVE-2026-134353)
description: rclone versions prior to 1.76.0 have a vulnerability in their swift, netstorage, and seafile backends where credentials can be leaked due to improper handling of HTTP redirects. Specifically, these backends follow redirects using Go's default policy, which causes authentication headers or passwords to be sent on cross-host or HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects, exposing sensitive credentials to attackers who can observe or receive these redirects.
